YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy notice.

This website introduces the lighting and infrastructure services of Voltronix Contracting LLC. For questions about your information, contact info@voltronix.ae.

Project enquiries

The enquiry form is provided by Zoho CRM. When you submit it, your contact details are sent to Zoho CRM for VOLTRONIX to review and respond to your enquiry. You can also contact us directly using the email, phone or WhatsApp links.

Contacting VOLTRONIX

If you send an enquiry, VOLTRONIX receives the information you include to discuss and respond to your project. Avoid sharing confidential drawings or sensitive information in an initial enquiry; agree a suitable transfer method with the team.

Links and technical information

The site uses locally hosted fonts and photographs. The embedded Zoho form loads scripts from Zoho, including form analytics, and may process technical data and cookies under Zoho’s privacy policy. The hosting provider may process technical access data to operate the website. Email providers, WhatsApp, the corporate VOLTRONIX site and other external services operate under their own privacy policies.

Questions and requests

For information about an enquiry you have sent, or to request a correction or deletion, email info@voltronix.ae. The team can explain what information is held and how your request can be handled.
